meaning_to_preserve: Draw all ordered outcomes, not just unordered pairs or totals
author_proposal.author_reason: เขียนว่า is a common way to introduce a written instruction without the พรอมต์/พร้อม trap. แบบมีลำดับทั้งหมด explicitly keeps every ordered outcome; สองลูก keeps two dice; ไม่ลำเอียง states fairness in common words.
author_proposal.remaining_uncertainty: Fair/unbiased dice and the word ลูกเต๋า still require a real future voice check. This wording does not prove that either TTS or ASR will distinguish every word.
